title: Closed Gaussian profile at zero
statement: The closed Gaussian profile, which equals the Gaussian isoperimetric profile for inputs strictly between $0$ and $1$ and equals $0$ otherwise, has value $0$ at $0$.
replaced: Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. Then $\overline I(0)=0$.
